results.content: This is a horizontal bar chart showing how 1,461 U.S. registered voters described President Trump in a Sept. 11–14, 2026, Economist/YouGov poll. Fewer voters described Trump as “strong” (37%), “intelligent” (35%), “effective” (33%), “honest” (23%), “inspiring” (19%), or “steady” (18%).
